companyFieldUpdates.description: AlphaGen manages and operates a large portfolio of gas- and oil-fired generation assets in major U.S. power markets. Its customer base is primarily wholesale power, capacity, and ancillary-services markets across PJM, NYISO, ISO-NE, and CAISO rather than retail end users. The platform follows an asset-heavy model built around dispatchable generating facilities and associated development, repowering, and grid-upgrade opportunities. Public disclosures describe approximately 13 to 14 gigawatts of capacity across 23 to 24 facilities in six states and nearly $2 billion of annual revenue at formation. The portfolio is concentrated in strategic markets where reliability, peaking capacity, and time-to-power have gained importance as electricity demand has risen. ArcLight created AlphaGen in January 2024, and ADIA agreed a $500 million minority investment in January 2025; a 2026 New York regulatory ruling identifies ArcLight Fund VII as the controlling sponsor and discloses ADIA's indirect 16.8% interest through Black Volt B 2024 LLC.
